title: Tamper with an income claim
description: Change a signed income threshold from false to true.
whyItMatters: Claims must remain bound to the issuer signature.

title: Use an untrusted issuer
description: Present a credential from an issuer that is not in the trusted registry.
whyItMatters: A valid signature is not enough if the issuer is not trusted.

title: Present expired KYC
description: Use a KYC credential that is past its validity window.
whyItMatters: Lenders must reject stale identity proofs.

title: Replay an old presentation
description: Submit the same lender request nonce a second time.
whyItMatters: Fresh nonces prevent captured proofs being reused.

title: Request over the ₹1,00,000 cap
description: Ask the agent to exceed the amount signed into the mandate.
whyItMatters: The permission engine enforces the borrower's hard ceiling.

title: Disclose employer name
description: Try to reveal an employer claim excluded from the mandate.
whyItMatters: Selective disclosure must never exceed borrower consent.

title: Accept without borrower signature
description: Have the agent accept an offer without a human signature.
whyItMatters: Only the borrower can make the final credit decision.

title: Revoke mandate mid-run
description: Revoke permission while an agent run is in progress.
whyItMatters: Revocation must halt every subsequent disclosure.
